nodes.title: A rastrillo repository hands Blueprint a graph that says what its code does (command, invariant, context, event, policy across contexts, event), and Blueprint accepts it as framework non-ddd
Named invariants in the starter, in RUS-83's shape (rule on the change, refuse, data-rule, verify, binding test)
make blueprint: .blueprint/graph.json and diagnostics.json from every app's committed flow.json v2
blueprint-go validates proposals and serves legalKinds by the session's framework (ddd | non-ddd)

forks.title: Extraction source: run the scenarios at extract time, or build from the committed flow.json

card.problem: Steward runs designTooling.extract before every design job; the graph needs what the scenarios land, which flow.json already holds, drift-checked.
useCases: A designer opens a session on a repo; Steward extracts before the job

options.label: Build from committed apps/*/docs/flow.json v2 with a root tool

walks.given: myapp's committed flow.json v2 at HEAD
walks.then: the root .blueprint/graph.json is written from flow.json alone, without running any scenario

options.label: Run every app's scenarios at extract time

walks.then: the scenarios run and .blueprint/ reflects the working tree, dirty or not

recommendation.why: flow.json is already the drift-checked map a Blueprint board renders from (AGENTS.md); extraction stays cheap and matches the pushed commit.

card.ifOverturned: Extraction would cost a whole scenario suite on every design job.

forks.title: Monorepo merge: one graph per repository against several apps

card.problem: Blueprint keeps one .blueprint/graph.json per repository; the starter can hold several apps.
useCases: Two apps both declaring an accounts context

options.label: Merge every app; subdomain = context; a clash is a nameCollisions entry

walks.given: apps a and b both declare context accounts
walks.then: diagnostics.json lists accounts under nameCollisions and make blueprint exits non-zero

options.label: Merge; subdomain = <app>-<context>

walks.text: No clash possible, app in every id

options.label: One graph per app (Steward change)

recommendation.why: A context name is the business's word, unique across apps that talk over HTTP.

card.ifOverturned: Ids would carry app names, or Steward needs a change.

forks.title: Mixed-context entry point: which subdomain its command node gets

card.problem: A command node has one subdomain; one request may land directly in two contexts.
useCases: Join landing MemberJoined[accounts] and WelcomeNoteWritten[notes] directly, uncaused

options.label: One command node per (entry point, context), plus a mixedContextRequests diagnostic

walks.given: a flow.json entry_points list with Join in accounts and Join in notes
walks.then: graph has accounts_cmd_join and notes_cmd_join, and diagnostics.mixedContextRequests names Join

options.label: One node in the context with most facts

walks.then: one accounts_cmd_join producing a notes event

options.label: A synthetic mixed subdomain

recommendation.why: It mirrors flow.json's per-context entry_points and draws the smell instead of hiding it.

card.ifOverturned: The board would hide a mixed request.

card.problem: Change records do not carry the policy's name; the Go function name is in no record.

options.label: {From}Then{To} in the target context

walks.given: myapp's flow.json policy MemberJoined[accounts] to WelcomeNoteWritten[notes]
walks.then: graph has node notes_pol_member-joined-then-welcome-note-written with triggers from accounts_evt_member-joined and produces to notes_evt_welcome-note-written

options.label: Declared policy names beside the reasons, held by a binding test
A policy column on the record

recommendation.why: No code change; option 2 can replace it later (renaming ids).

card.ifOverturned: Policy ids would differ from day one.

forks.title: Diagnostics: which are emitted and which fail make ci

card.problem: ADR 0003 says the map never fails on what it finds; pv3's CLI exits 1 on topology violations and collisions.
useCases: An extractor bug emits an illegal edge; an invariant no command guards

options.label: Fail on topologyViolations and nameCollisions only; report orphans and flow findings as extra keys

walks.given: the extractor emits event produces event
walks.then: diagnostics.topologyViolations names the edge and make blueprint exits non-zero

walks.given: a declared invariant no command or policy guards
walks.then: diagnostics.orphanNodes names it and make blueprint exits zero

options.label: Fail on nothing
Fail on orphans too

recommendation.why: Enforces only tool defects and cross-app ambiguity; ADR 0003 stays whole.

card.ifOverturned: Either defects ship or ADR 0003 is broken.

forks.title: Non-ddd grammar extras beyond the four settled edges

card.problem: Settled: command produces event, command guarded-by invariant, event triggers policy, policy produces event. What else is legal in non-ddd?
useCases: agent:bank opens BankReportedTransaction; NoteWritten writes notes

options.label: Add external-system invokes command and event writes-to datastore; keep ui invokes command

walks.when: the design agent proposes bank_ext_bank invokes bank_cmd_bank-reported-transaction

walks.given: myapp's flow.json declares NoteWritten writes notes

options.label: Only external-system invokes command
Only the four settled edges

recommendation.why: The kept mapping already has tracked table → datastore and agent → external-system; each needs exactly one triple.

card.ifOverturned: Agents and table ownership vanish from the board.

forks.title: Example invariants the starter ships in myapp

card.problem: The starter declares no invariant; the title check is form validation, out of RUS-83's scope.
useCases: A member submits a correction that changes nothing

options.label: ACorrectionChangesSomething guards NoteCorrected (refuse) and EveryNewMemberIsWelcomed shapes WelcomeNoteWritten:[notes] (By)

walks.given: a member's note titled Groceries with body milk
walks.when: the member posts the correction with title Groceries and body milk
walks.then: 422, the page carries data-rule=ACorrectionChangesSomething, no change lands, and one refused log line names the rule, entry point CorrectNote, context notes, actor and trace id
the WelcomeNoteWritten change carries rule EveryNewMemberIsWelcomed

options.label: Only the guard
None

recommendation.why: Exercises both halves of RUS-83's shape through existing scenarios.

card.ifOverturned: The starter teaches half the shape, or none.

forks.title: How framework travels from the repo to blueprint-go

card.problem: framework (ddd | non-ddd) lives in .blueprint.config.json; blueprint-go has no repository table.
useCases: Steward pushes myapp's graph, then the agent proposes a policy produces event edge

options.label: Extractor stamps framework at the top of graph.json; blueprint-go reads the session's latest reality graph, default ddd

walks.given: a session whose latest reality graph has framework non-ddd
walks.when: the design agent proposes notes_pol_x produces notes_evt_y
walks.then: the proposal is accepted and the view's legalKinds lists produces from policy to event

walks.given: a session whose latest reality graph has no framework field
walks.when: the agent proposes policy produces event
walks.then: refused as EdgeKindNotAllowed, exactly as today

options.label: Steward sends framework beside the graph
A session setting set by hand

recommendation.why: One source, the repository; zero Steward changes; pv3 graphs stay ddd.

card.ifOverturned: Steward and the reality contract change.

forks.title: blueprint-go scope: Go side only, or the island too

card.problem: The island is mid-rewrite in the owner's uncommitted WIP, which uses blueprint-schema's DDD allowedEdgeKinds client-side.
useCases: A non-ddd session draws policy produces event

options.label: Go side only: grammar by framework, proposal validator, legalKinds by framework, instructions.txt; island deferred

walks.text: Every Go-side check of edge legality takes the session's framework; no file under apps/server/island changes in this work.

options.label: Go side plus island now

recommendation.why: Island work waits until the WIP lands.

card.problem: Commit the graph, or generate it from the committed flow.json?
useCases: The owner runs make blueprint locally

options.label: Generated and gitignored; .blueprint.config.json committed with designTooling.extract and framework non-ddd

walks.text: .blueprint/ is in .gitignore; .blueprint.config.json names designTooling.extract = make blueprint and framework = non-ddd.

options.label: Committed with a drift check

walks.text: Two drift checks over one fact.

recommendation.why: flow.json is already the committed truth.

card.ifOverturned: Two drift checks over one fact.

forks.title: Where a shaping rule on a policy-landed event attaches

card.problem: EveryNewMemberIsWelcomed shapes WelcomeNoteWritten, which a policy lands, not a command; RUS-83 settled shapes draws guarded-by for commands only.
useCases: Join → MemberJoined[accounts] ⟹ MemberJoinedThenWelcomeNoteWritten → WelcomeNoteWritten[notes], rule EveryNewMemberIsWelcomed

options.label: Add policy guarded-by invariant to non-ddd

walks.given: myapp's flow.json with rule EveryNewMemberIsWelcomed on the WelcomeNoteWritten hop
walks.then: graph has notes_pol_member-joined-then-welcome-note-written guarded-by notes_inv_every-new-member-is-welcomed and no orphan

options.label: Attach to the entry command Join
No edge, orphan reported

recommendation.why: The rule lives in the reacting context and the policy is its only writer.

card.ifOverturned: The invariant floats or sits in the wrong context's flow.
